title: Petroglyph National Monument: Bicycle Use In The Monument
summary: Bicycles are ONLY allowed at the following locations: 1 - On the Boca Negra Canyon paved multiuse path; bicycles must remain on the paved bike path. 2 - On the crusher fine trail that winds in and out of the park around the mesa top above Boca Negra.

title: Bandelier National Monument: The Use of GPS is NOT Recommended
summary: Numerous visitors have been routed to remote trailheads and out-of-the-way roads trying to use GPS to reach the main park area or shuttle stop.

title: Bandelier National Monument: Uber, Lyft, and Other "Taxi" Services
summary: Bandelier is in a remote location, with cell service in the canyon limited to Verizon 4G only. Services like Uber and Lyft will bring you here, but there may be no way to contact a ride out. Please plan your pickup before being dropped off at Bandelier.

title: Petroglyph National Monument: Attention Visitors, Cab drivers, Uber drivers, and transportation service drivers
summary: DO NOT drop off your passengers at the visitor center. No trail access. Visitors must be driven to a trail system from the visitor center. If passengers want to go to the visitor center, WAIT FOR THEM in the parking lot until they come back out.

title: Petroglyph National Monument: Be City Smart: Take precautions to secure your vehicle and valuables.
